newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Fischer says budgets reduce pressure on rates, A$.
newsitem.headline: Fischer says budgets reduce pressure on rates, A$.

text.p: Australian Trade Minister Tim Fischer said on Tuesday that the government's budget strategy would help put downward pressure on interest rates and the Australian dollar's exchange rate.
"Our strategy from our first two budgets should help reduce pressure on interest rates and therefore on the exchange rate," Fischer told a conference of the National Farmers Federation.

"This will provide the basis for better returns to the international trading sectors of the Australian economy and allow us to start improving our position in the international competitiveness stakes," Fischer said.
